name: Beijing Zhongke WengeAI Science and Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Zhongke WengeAI Science and Technology Co., Ltd. develops enterprise-level artificial intelligence full-stack technology infrastructure in China and Hong Kong. Its products include AI Data Platform DIP, which structures business data into machine-readable rules; YAYI, an enterprise-level foundation large model; ScienceOne, a fusion scientific foundation model; Claworks, an agent operating system for enterprises; and Decitron, an AI system for scenario simulation and decision support. The company also offers capabilities to cover data governance, domain knowledge management, large language and multimodal model training, decision automation and evaluation, and AI application developmen…
